Hello! I'm an UTAU/Vtuber from Finland. I hope you can draw me : https://sta.sh/0ena8gonmuy  

 She is very energetic and outoing. She loves everything cute and sweet, but she's also a tsundere. She loves Kuromi and Hello Kitty a lot.   

I really like this artwork of yours, maybe draw something similar like it? >w<)d : https://twitter.com/aysr001/status/1459118341038088192?s=21

You can choose her pose and facial expression, you have artistic freedom.
 You can do anything, but I would love menhera, goth/punk and Kuromi/Hellokitty as theme. Outfit can be changed, but please keep her hair and eye color the same. Thank you!

Please see this moodboard for inspiration :  https://pin.it/271gOJg


I would love if you could add extra chibi illustration in the back. >< 

The illustration would be used for SNS, Twitch and Youtube. Please use #sagawart if you post it to Twitter!

 Thank you so much, I hope you will have a nice day! ❣️💞💗💓
